title: My Best Friend Moved Away | Cozy Corgi Town
notes: Bobo moves to a new house over the hill. Hammi is heartbroken until the whole town turns up in Dwight's bus to take him to surprise Bobo. Lighting carries the mood: golden -> grey and rainy -> sun breaking through -> sunset. Group shots (s19, s20) are the riskiest; expect to re-roll them. Hammi side-eyes Dany (a cat) until he smells her bread (s12/s12a); cuts the cake and keeps the big slice (s20/s20a). Toozi brings the road-trip music (s15a) and the party music (s19a); Vivi is picked up at the bus stop (s13a). Kids' show: cocoa, not tea; cake server, not knife. New: Jul (hip goat) boards the bus with a pose (s13b); Molly (ecstatic duck) cheers at the reunion (s19b).
